17088:     function renderRosters() {
17089:       const data = state.rosters;
17090:       if (!data) return;
17091:       const initial = Number(data.settings?.initial_credits || 0);
17092:       const assignments = data.assignments || [];
17093:       const creditStates = data.creditStates || [];
17094:       const creditStateByTeam = Object.fromEntries(
17095:         creditStates.map(item => [item.team_id, item])
17096:       );
17097:       const spent = assignments.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+Number(item.purchase_price||0),0);
17098:       const penalties = creditStates.reduce(
17099:         (sum,item)=>sum+Number(item.nomination_penalty_credits||0),
17100:         0
17101:       );
17102: 
17103:       $('roster-kpis').innerHTML = `
17104:         <div class="kpi"><span>Squadre</span><strong>${(data.teams||[]).length}</strong></div>
17105:         <div class="kpi"><span>Giocatori</span><strong>${assignments.length}</strong></div>
17106:         <div class="kpi"><span>Spesa acquisti</span><strong>${spent}</strong></div>
17107:         <div class="kpi"><span>Penalità</span><strong>${penalties}</strong></div>
17108:       `;
17109: 
17110:       $('rosters-grid').innerHTML = (data.teams || []).map(team => {
17111:         const rows = assignments.filter(item => item.team_id === team.id);
17112:         const teamSpent = rows.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+Number(item.purchase_price||0),0);
17113:         const creditState = creditStateByTeam[team.id] || null;
17114:         const remaining = creditState
17115:           ? Number(creditState.remaining_credits || 0)
17116:           : Math.max(0, initial - teamSpent);
17117:         const penalty = Number(creditState?.nomination_penalty_credits || 0);
17118:         const adjustment = Number(creditState?.credit_adjustment || 0);
17119:         return `
17120:           <details class="team-card" open>
17121:             <summary><div><strong>${esc(team.name)}</strong><span class="small soft"> · ${esc(team.presidentUsername || 'senza Presidente')}</span></div><span class="badge">${rows.length} · ${remaining} CR</span></summary>
17122:             <div class="small soft" style="padding:4px 10px 0">Acquisti ${teamSpent} · Penalità ${penalty}${adjustment ? ` · Rettifica ${adjustment > 0 ? '+' : ''}${adjustment}` : ''}</div>
17123:             <div class="roster-body">
17124:               ${rows.map(item => `<div class="roster-player"><div><strong>${esc(item.player?.name || '—')}</strong><span class="small soft"> · ${esc((item.player?.mantra_roles || [item.player?.classic_role]).filter(Boolean).join('/'))} · ${esc(item.player?.serie_a_team || '')}</span></div><span class="badge primary">${Number(item.purchase_price||0)}</span></div>`).join('') || '<div class="small soft">Rosa vuota.</div>'}
17125:             </div>
17126:           </details>
17127:         `;
17128:       }).join('');
17129:     }
